event_record.op_id: UUID or null for unrelated activity

witnesses.foreground_sentinel: Separate test app remains frontmost during background tests; emits periodic unique text into its own field and records complete received sequence. No user typing required. Stop immediately if any real user activity appears.
witnesses.focus: Combine workspace activation and window key/main notification logs with periodic frontmost PID/window sampling. Record sampling period and uncovered gaps; external witness must not change focus.
witnesses.hardware_cursor: Sample actual hardware pointer independently of synthetic ring; record sample rate and measurement limitations. Do not infer position from captured image cursor alone.
witnesses.screenshot: Capture PNG reference of fixture-generated geometry plus target JPEG output; record SHA256, file bytes, pixel dimensions, capture_id, timestamps, source window/display metadata.
witnesses.transport: Log exact synthetic JSON bytes, request ID, connection epoch, send/receive/cancel/timeout events; redact nothing necessary because fixture contains no real data.
witnesses.file_output: One dedicated run directory; log creation/write/delete; after close settle barrier ensure no new publication. File recreated by late capture is a recorded compatibility hazard.

states.covered: opaque sentinel window fully covers target; target remains running
states.minimized: minimize fixture via authorized setup; verify reported state before dispatch
states.locked: manual authorized lock; never attempt bypass; collect only permitted witnesses; unlock manually; reconcile effects afterwards
states.different_space: target in different Space; no implicit switching allowed
states.multiscreen_negative_origin: screen arranged left or above primary; record real bounds
states.multiscreen_mixed_DPI: record point/pixel ratios on each display; source moves only during explicit phase; capture fresh mapping before normal action

run_control.clock: injected deterministic clock for pure/mock tests; monotonic actual clock for OS tests
run_control.operation_deadline: test-chosen 10 seconds after receipt for normal receiver effects; timeout is INCONCLUSIVE/FAIL by layer, never auto retry; not Alma constant
run_control.settle_barrier: await all owned callbacks or record unresolved operation. A finite silence interval alone does not prove no future callback.
